column1: # P0.2 mutgate spec — ADR-001 (031) boundary probe suite.
# Each row breaks THE BEHAVIOUR ITS ROW NAMES and must turn that row red.
# Row 1 uses the make target itself (P0.2's green criterion); rows 2-7 assert one
# row each, so a red is attributable to that row and not to a neighbour.
# NO PIPES IN A test_cmd. mutgate.sh runs `eval` under its own `set -o pipefail`
# (:35, :62), and `grep -q` exits at the first match, so the suite upstream of it
# takes SIGPIPE and the pipeline returns 141 — a BASELINE RED that says nothing
# about the row. Measured while building this spec: the piped form scored
# baseline red / mutated red on a row that discriminates perfectly. So each row
# redirects to a log and greps the FILE.
